body.x: DJI participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced various drones with excellent technology.
Featuring all of DJI’s signature technology, the mini-unmanned aerial vehicle, Spark is equipped with intelligent flight control options, a mechanical gimbal, and a camera for high-quality images.

DJI Mavic Pro is small but a powerful unmanned aerial vehicle. This features DJI’s leading technologies such as compact size, sophisticated flight cameras, 24 high-performance computing cores, a new transmission system ranging of 4.3 mi (7 km), five vision sensors and a stablized 4K camera with a 3-axis mechanical gimbal are equipped.

DJI Phantom 4 advance is equipped with a 1-inch 20-megapixel sensor capable of taking 4K/60fps videos and bust mode still of 14fps. FlightAutonomy system is a system equipped with 5 vision sensors for 2-way obstacle detection and frontal obstacle avoidance, enhancing the stability of the drone.

DJI INSPIRE drone can record up to 5.2K on CinemaDNG RAW with new image processing system. The dual-battery system also extends the flight times up to 27 minutes(using X4S) and can even fly at low temperature with self-heating technology.

Matrix 600 Pro (M600 Pro) has improved flight performance and better loading capacity than its previous model. Pre-installed arms and antennas reduce the required time for installation, and the modular design of the system makes it easy to mount additional modules. The aircraft is equipped with the latest DJI technology, including the A3 Pro flight controller, Lightbridge 2 HD transmission system, intelligent battery and battery management system. All Zenmuse cameras and gimbals are basically compatible. M600 Pro is an ideal product for professional aerial photography and industrial applications fields.

DJI goggles are manufactured to operate the drones perfectly. The goggles are equipped with a direct control function such as a pair of large super-high-definition screens, long-distance, low-speed wireless connection and photos and video capture.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
